summary: Partition long-running Unix CI gates without reducing the supported-host test set, and align the macOS temporary-root assertion with the canonical host path.

migration.note: Default local CI and focused-test invocations still execute the complete unsharded gate set. Shard parameters are additive.

compatibility.note: Windows retains full sequential jobs; Ubuntu and macOS execute the same gates as independently reportable base, focused, smoke, and profile-matrix jobs.
